meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目中的未使用代码——未用导入、常量、函数、类型、参数和孤立文件,用 LSP 确认引用数为零后再删;按文件分组派并行子代理执行,每批跑类型检查并单独提交,最后跑类型检查、测试和构建。
howto.when: 当你说「remove dead code」「dead code」「cleanup」等关键词时触发;也可以指定文件路径、目录或符号名来缩小扫描范围。

say.text: 把整个项目里没用到的代码清理掉
say.note: 先扫描候选、LSP 逐条确认,再并行删除并分组提交

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的死代码
say.note: 扫描范围会限定到该目录

say.text: 确认一下 unusedFunc 没人引用就把它删了
say.note: 先用 LSP 查引用,零引用才删

howto.what_en: Claude scans the project for unused code — imports, constants, functions, types, parameters, orphaned files — confirms each via LSP, and dispatches parallel agents grouped by file. Each agent typechecks and commits separately.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like “remove dead code”, “dead code” or “cleanup”. You can also narrow the scan to a file path, directory or symbol name.

say_en.text: Clean up all the unused code in this project
say_en.note: Scans candidates, LSP-verifies, then removes in parallel

say_en.text: Only clean dead code under src/utils
say_en.note: Limits the scan to that directory

say_en.text: Check if unusedFunc has any references, delete it if none
say_en.note: Uses LSP first; removes only with zero references
